response.overview: A pine twig plays with a sunbeam and surveys the world. Next to him grows a girl-twig. Children's games are replaced by modest courtship. The wedding march. Firefly blows his lantern... A small twig grows between them. He wants a pacifier. A storm is coming. The pine shakes menacingly, but they survive. The sun pushes the clouds away with his hands. Father-branch went bald. He's reading the paper, and the mother is knitting. A pine twig - their son - begins to play with the sunbeam.
response.title: Prikazka za borovoto klonche
